svg.text: PLAN 3, EAST HALF: Dead Man's Cave, down the creek to the Storm Drain
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m · room site_prebuilt_fairy_forest_ow_clearing
fire lookout · level, a board fits
THE LOW GROUND: mud, dead trees, drain pipes (no pool)
rowboat, swing · level, a board fits
fenced yard: chain-link, a locked shed
SECOND WAY, 2 squares (a bed, a lane)
open ground (a clearing, a field, a yard)
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.
Plot lines by district: C = The Clearing · M = Dead Man's Cave · L = the trail north. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height.
